leadText:
Gilbert (Japanese: ゲンキ Genki) is a character of the day who appeared in Saved by the Beldum. He is a Pokémon Trainer who competed in the preliminary rounds of the Ever Grande Conference. 

Gilbert went up against during the preliminary rounds. Using his , he was determined to defeat Ash's Pikachu. However, 's speed caused his Pokémon's s to miss and injure his leg. He was able to gain a slight advantage when Hitmonlee used on Pikachu, but the Pokémon ended up losing the . With that loss, Gilbert was out of the tournament.
